simple.summary: בִּלְשָׁן (Bilshân) means Bilshan , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 2.

definitions.full: H1114. Bilshan בִּלְשָׁן proper name, masculine (= inquirer ? Late Hebrew & Aramaic בלשׁ ; compare below בן ) an Israelite who returned with Zerubbabel Ezra 2:2 = Neh 7:7 .
